finding: Codex CP2 review 1, finding 2: probe_passed ignored route_fit, and probe records dropped it
method: derived from the retained records only; no held-out case was run again. The packer turn has no history, so it cannot repack; every planning send calls the packer's record_dispatch (planning_loop._invoke_planning_gateway); a fit that returns None ends the run with CONTEXT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED. So an exact probe that completed and a one-over probe that stopped on a budget code had every request fitted
